comment: Dr. Grollman is very funny and caring. He makes time for his students in and out of class. If you tell him youre struggling, hell help in a heart beat.

unclear grading criteria. nit-picky with points. worst professor I've ever taken at UR. did worse in his class (he made it unnecessarily hard) than in Orgo and his class dropped my GPA (?!?!). would recommend NO one takes him; he really shouldn't teach because he is terrible. Taught wrong information, wouldn't listen to the correction of students.

Dr. Grollman is probably the worst teacher I have ever had. He's a disgraceful lecturer. Unclear with what he expects from you, and then takes loads of points off for not giving him exactly what he wants. If you need to take SOC 101, take it with ANY other teacher.

good person. not so great teacher. does not give clear guidelines then punishes you with deducted points when you don't give them exactly what they were looking for even though they didn't make it clear. this is my second class with them and i will not be taking another. disappointing

For an intro class, Grollman made the course much harder than it needed to be. His grading was inconsistent, unclear, and he was very unhelpful outside of class.  I would not recommend taking a course with him

AWESOME AWESOME teacher. I put in a little bit of effort and got an A. Methods in general can be very boring but he made it as engaging as he possibly could. Was always willing to stay after class and help people, and made time to sit down with students when they didn't understand something. Would take again in a heartbeat

Made Methods as interesting and engaging as it can be. He was a great teacher and resource in and outside of the classroom. I put in minimal effort and got a B. Just do the readings and pay attention in class. I would strongly recommend him for any Soc class and I hope to take him again in the future.
